title: Why can't I send more than $500 per day?
summary: This document explains why sending more than $500/day may be blocked: either your account is under the default $750 daily cap, or the amount you tried exceeds your remaining daily allowance after earlier payments. It also covers fixes: verify for a higher cap up to $3,500 (approval required), send a smaller amount within remaining allowance, or wait for the daily period to renew. It notes daily and monthly caps both apply.
